edits.text: Claim. Offence at what the Post believes or claims, such as that Jesus is the only way to God. The Bible calls this kind of offence a stumbling block (1 Corinthians 1:23); Culture and Ministry Design (p. 28) calls it "the offence of the gospel". Reported, but never lowers a score. Whether a given offence is the offence of the gospel is for you and your group to talk through.
